evals.prompt: Define lint-overlay in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the lint-overlay skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.
Describe the mental model or main primitives behind lint-overlay. Keep it operational rather than just naming the topic.
A user asks: "decide whether to unit-test or integration-test this handler". Should lint-overlay activate? Explain the boundary and name the better owner when possible.
evals.negative_expectation: Must not force lint-overlay onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to pattern-recognition, debugging, refactor, skill-infrastructure, problem-locating-solving, testing-strategy, integration-test-design.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "plan ESLint rule introduction for a monorepo that has never had linting". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying lint-overlay.

Place lint-overlay among its adjacent skills (pattern-recognition, debugging, refactor, skill-infrastructure, problem-locating-solving, testing-strategy, integration-test-design). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
evals.negative_expectation: Must not collapse related skills into interchangeable names; ownership must be mechanism-level.
